cases.summary: Eleven members of the Milligan University cycling team were on a morning training ride on US Highway 19E near Simerly Creek Road when a driver struck the group. Haylan and Brayden, both sophomores, were killed; seven teammates were taken to Johnson City Medical Center, four in critical condition. The driver was arrested the same day.
cases.charges: two counts of vehicular homicide by recklessness, five counts of aggravated assault by vehicle; investigation ongoing

cases.summary: Shiloh was riding her e-bike south on Pine Street, wearing a helmet, when a driver traveling the same direction struck her near Locust Street. She died that evening at the University of Vermont Medical Center. A rising junior at Burlington High School, she was honored weeks later by hundreds of riders moving through the city in her memory.
cases.charges: negligent operation with death resulting; court appearance scheduled Aug 27, 2026
